## Concern
Describe the issue and the affected code/report section.

## Evidence
Use public evidence or a fictional minimal example. Do not attach private workbooks, addresses or source-row exports.

## Expected handling
Explain the flag, correction or sensitivity check that would address it.

## Scope
Does this affect historical metrics, metadata, dashboard wording or forecast availability?
